summary:
I revised the C62H-BOUND build brief: it went from 540 lines (ba6bdeb0) to 662 lines (sha256 cffbe0651f20d2ac7ea92a58e094a23184d6f063087bfa6cde800beca5e0a472), with no line over 120 characters. It applies the advisor's conditions 1-7 and records its rulings: B-1 yes, B-2 in commit 3 with condition 5, B-3 confirmed as 93509dfd7fd1, and the order stands. It also applies the test-engineer's conditions 1-5: TE-CBB-1 to -10 and -12 are carried into the brief, and TE-CBB-11 is deferred in writing.

- **Route:** W only, with one agent launch per commit step. The main session commits each step and runs the insert script's part 1 before step 1, and part 3 plus the built check before step 3.
- **SIZE-CHECK:** results/ is excluded, the count also runs after the fix pass, and the total is taken at the last code commit.
- **Section 10:** quotes the post's three stop rules and its size line word for word. A check confirmed that brief lines 603-607 equal paste lines 120-124 exactly, and that lines 609-611 joined equal paste line 89. The advisor's reading follows, including the planted-bug rule written as a conjunction.
- **Test-engineer conditions:** each of the three evidence scripts must first be shown to fail on a planted input, and the compare script checks the earlier verdicts' full sha256 first. Each gap case must show its own note text, with the gap pair that hid each other now separated. The bite-run summary comparison is written out, the expected test counts are stated (final 552/632), and seven new planted bugs (CB-P12 to -18) are added.

No frozen text, figure meaning or step changed. Two deviations: this seat had no Edit tool, so the brief was rewritten whole with Write and checked by hashing the unchanged lines. The word diff was taken against e83ae52 (the old blob) instead of a copy under .gate/. The background saver committed the final brief as autosave 09cca21; this seat made no commit. The item-to-lines map and the word-diff summary are in /home/user/Shamble-Frontlines/.checkpoints/netcode-proof-test/c62h-bound-brief-rev-notes.md; the brief is /home/user/Shamble-Frontlines/.checkpoints/netcode-proof-test/c62h-bound-brief.md.
